subject.title: Constantly reoccuring keychain prompt for "Claude Code-credentials"

question: What packaged current-main evidence is sufficient to confirm whether CodexBar or one of its helpers still triggers this background Keychain prompt?
rationale: Source shows a plausible retired path but does not prove which executable and call site produced the reporter’s v0.42.1 prompts or whether current main resolves them.

options.title: Capture packaged attribution
options.body: Reproduce with a freshly packaged current-main app and collect a redacted screen recording plus unified-log attribution identifying the requesting executable and Claude credential reader.

options.title: Treat reader retirement as sufficient
options.body: Accept the current-main strategy fallback as the fix and close only after identifying its exact commit and proving release or main-only provenance.

recommendation.title: Capture packaged attribution
recommendation.body: Reproduce with a freshly packaged current-main app and collect a redacted screen recording plus unified-log attribution identifying the requesting executable and Claude credential reader.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available owner for packaged-app validation and the Claude credential boundary.
